title: Owner: srs-web holds only generic code for public packages; layers are never merged

sections.name: words
sections.content: "I may have not paid quite enough attention before. We cannot merge layers. if this means that we don't have the mudemocracy editor on the generic srs-web then so be it. Lets make sure that srs-web has a clear layer test. srs-web contains only reusable generic code that applies to packages that are public. no code specific to any particular implementation can appear in generic srs-web code."

sections.name: context
sections.content: 2026-11-12. Said on reviewing srs-web#796 (B2 PR 1), which put muDemocracy's evidence rules into srs-web's src/lib/site/mudemocracy/, the site layer ADR-029 allowed as a temporary home. The ruling retires that home: an implementation's rules stay in its own repository, even at the cost of a muDemocracy-specific editor in srs-web.
